name: agentic-readiness-assessment
description: Evaluates a software repository for readiness to be developed and maintained by AI coding agents, and reports an evidence-based readiness scorecard. A second skill audits how much of your agents' run time goes to slow tool calls.

interface.shortDescription: Score a repository's readiness for AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Inspect a software repository in place, verify its agent development feedback loops, and produce an evidence-based readiness scorecard with prioritized recommendations. A second skill, agent-tool-call-latency, measures every tool call your agents made from local session history and ranks fixes for the time they spend waiting.
defaultPrompt: Assess this repository's readiness for AI coding agents.
Generate an evidence-based agentic readiness scorecard.
Identify the highest-priority blockers to autonomous agent work.
